g.text: -- guarantees one DM channel per user pair
CHECK (kind='group' AND name IS NOT NULL AND dm_key IS NULL
OR kind='direct' AND name IS NULL AND dm_key IS NOT NULL)
-- NULL until ready; assigned by the worker
-- from ffprobe, never from the client
-- originals/{random}.{ext} in the media volume (deleted once ready)
-- pending | done | failed; NULL when transcription is off
• aggregated on the bubble: delivered n/m, played n/m
Ephemeral state lives in Redis, not Postgres:
presence:{channel_id} ZSET member "{user_id}:{conn_id}", score = last heartbeat
online = users with a member scored > now − 60 s (multi-tab + crash safe:
a dead api pod stops heart-beating, its entries expire on their own)
player:{channel_id}:{user_id} the connection that plays the channel for that user
ratelimit:{scope}:{key} sliding-window ZSETs (login, signup, upload, channel and DM creation)
